name: E2E: Ambiguous request requires clarification before ticket creation
objective: Validate the complete end-to-end journey where a user provides a vague description, the assistant asks clarifying questions across multiple turns, correctly classifies the request, and creates the ticket with full conversation context.
precondition: User has valid credentials. Routing rules are configured for Identity and Access Management queue.

steps.description: Log in to the self-service portal and navigate to home page
steps.expectedResult: Home page loads with Agentforce icon visible

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon to open the AI Assistant

steps.testData: "I have a problem with my account"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant has low confidence and asks clarifying questions

steps.testData: "I cannot log in to the HR system"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant identifies access/authentication issue and asks further

steps.testData: "I am getting an error saying my account is locked"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant classifies this as an Incident

steps.description: Verify the assistant gathers remaining details and presents summary
steps.expectedResult: Complete summary is presented with all conversation context
Incident is created with full conversation context

steps.description: Verify the incident is routed to Identity and Access Management queue
steps.expectedResult: Assignment Group shows Identity and Access Management queue
